prompt_text: What is the best Airbnb or short term rental to book in Nashville for a family of four?
engine_stated_criteria: dates, nightly or total budget, children’s ages, and whether you’ll have a car
answer_verbatim:
The best fit depends on your dates, budget, and what you plan to do, but for a family of four I’d start with a **two-bedroom, two-bath rental in East Nashville**. It’s a good balance of space, a neighborhood feel, and access to downtown—one listing describes a two-bedroom cottage with a full kitchen, laundry, parking, and patio, about 2.5 miles from downtown. [Browse East Nashville family-friendly stays on Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.com/east-nashville-tn/stays/family-friendly)

If you’d rather be within walking distance of Broadway and downtown attractions, look at **SoBro** for a two-bedroom apartment—but expect more noise and potentially extra parking fees. [Browse Nashville family-friendly stays on Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.com/nashville-tn/stays/family-friendly)

Before booking, check the total price including cleaning and service fees, parking, bed setup, cancellation terms, and recent reviews mentioning noise and cleanliness. I can narrow this to a specific listing if you share your **dates, nightly or total budget, children’s ages, and whether you’ll have a car**.
